guards.situation: The customer tries to add a product that has sizes to the cart without choosing a size first; the add is refused.
guards.old_where: lib/features/shop/product_detail_screen.dart:39-48 (_addToCart: if product.needsSize && _selectedSize == null -> toast and return); old button :273-274
guards.customer_sees: A toast at the top: warning icon, title 'Velikost', text 'Nejdriv vyber velikost'; nothing is added.
guards.server: partly (create_shop_order rejects a size that is not in products.sizes with bad_size, 20260924d:101; it cannot know that a size was forgotten — a product with sizes added without size would fail only if its id has no size suffix; not verified further)
v2_where: lib/features/shop/product_detail_screen.dart:41-45 (same _addToCart, v2 branch sets _sizeHint and returns); lib/features/shop/v2/product_view_v2.dart:150-155 (inline warn banner v2UxPsPickSize under the size chips) ; dock CTA :191-200 calls onAdd = _addToCart (product_detail_screen.dart:125)
guards.verdict_evidence: The check itself is identical (same _addToCart). But the v2 message is an inline banner placed under the size chips inside the scroll body, while the add button sits in the fixed dock; v2 does not scroll the banner into view and shows no toast. On a short phone or when the page is scrolled so the size chips are off-screen, tapping 'Pridat do kosiku' appears to do nothing. Whether the chips are off-screen depends on photo height (4:3), description length and screen height — not measured here.
